subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should sessions.files.list ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR's central backend fix changes a security-sensitive file metadata boundary, and current related proposals disagree between filtering external entries and exposing limited metadata.

options.title: Preserve fs-safe boundary
options.body: Filter or neutralize workspace-external entries without raw fs.stat and add outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory regression coverage.

options.title: Accept external metadata
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external file metadata only with explicit security/product approval plus protocol and UI tests for the new contract.

options.title: Split layout from backend
options.body: Keep the already-merged layout direction and handle Missing-label semantics in the linked issue or a fresh focused PR.

recommendation.title: Preserve fs-safe boundary
recommendation.body: Filter or neutralize workspace-external entries without raw fs.stat and add outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original rail feature and current-main layout follow-up, so they are the best available owner for the boundary and rebase direction.
